The pursuit falters as your shots bite into its leading ranks.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Agility
Target / range / shape
Up to three visible creatures within 8 squares
Duration
Instant
Equipment / acquisition
Requires and grants one ordinary ranged weapon and one d8 ammunition bundle if each is absent; Bulk 1 each. Check ammunition once per attack, not per target.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

For a player attack, work out each target’s net Boons or Banes. Make one attack roll using the combination least favorable to you and apply that result to every target. Affect the creatures specified under Target, including allies if the area includes them. When an NPC attacks, each affected player makes a separate defense roll.

Weak
4 physical damage to each; Slowed 1.
Standard
4 physical damage to each; Slowed 2.
Strong
6 physical damage to each; Slowed 3.
